policy: Criterion-level sufficiency review. Proven is limited to the exact wording and cited proof; accepted_amendment retains unfinished obligations under explicit successor scope authority without claiming implementation completion. Missing or indirect execution proof remains non_proving. Historical review records are provenance, not substitutes for semantic proof.

scope_amendments.exact_excerpt: Broader post-move-in operational hardening is tracked in #624 and does not block #497 closure. That sidecar owns GitHub/CI authority hardening, DNS and certificate ownership/rollback readbacks, AWS account guardrails, private custody receipt, and deployment rollback readback.

scope_amendments.body:
Operator scope clarification: #483 is accepted as the read-only custody register pass. Its remaining operational work is explicitly non-gating and now has concrete unscheduled backlog authority:

- #703 — GitHub organization custody and recovery
- #702 — GitHub CI authority and emergency controls
- #701 — domain custody and DNS delegation recovery
- #699 — certificate renewal and recovery authority
- #698 — AWS business-account audit and recovery guardrails
- #700 — deployment authority and rollback recovery
- #704 — private vault custody and non-single-factor recovery (including the related email, brand/private-instrument, and assignment-custody residuals)

All seven are labeled `track:backlog`, have no milestone, and grant no live administrative or infrastructure mutation authority.

<!-- csdlc-github-operation:corp-b-readonly-backlog-routing-v1 -->

grouped_root_causes.smallest_remediation: Complete per-asset control/dependency/recovery/rollback mapping from existing records, and prove missing-field rejection. No provider mutation needed.
Need existing redacted approval/execution/use-rights evidence or exact applicable amendment. Code and GitHub closure cannot produce private approval truth; do not expose private documents.
Map existing state recovery/cleanup/runbook evidence and explicit624 amendment before treating residual operations as current gate obligations.
Reuse actual codec/message-family/replay test evidence; contract fixture self-equality does not prove every family or committed replay.

Find existing independently started-voter, quorum, lease, AZ/partition/healing receipts. Any missing paid cloud execution requires applicable existing operator authorization; do not launch from this mapping.

Replace generated assertions with actual Runtime failure/feed/clock/replay/cleanup receipts from existing proof owners. deterministic_drt_c fabricates fixed metadata in-memory; another equality test cannot prove elapsed soak or provider cleanup.
Map approved repository migration inventory and exact visibility/history readbacks;497 operational-hardening deferral does not waive these safeguards.
